title: Intl minus the clock-reading member: number formatting and locale canonicalisation need no capability
notes: specification/compatibility.mdx, 'Host Globals': the rule is per-operation, not per-object. This is to `Intl` what 20-host-globals/universal-globals-stay-available is to `Math` — without it, adding `Intl` as an ambient root could be over-applied to the whole object and nothing would notice.
